csv_project_name: Design for Mackay Stadium North Endzone Seating
csv_scope_of_work: The University of Nevada, Reno (University) is seeking qualified suppliers to provide permanent stadium seating solutions for the north endzone of Mackay Stadium located on the University of Nevada, Reno campus in Reno, NV. The University intends to provide the full spectrum of available permanent seating configurations, from premium fixed seating to loge boxes to field level suites for this renovation project. This solicitation involves the purchase of a permanent seating structure and equipment from the selected supplier and consulting services in which the selected supplier will work collaboratively with the University s designated site design firm to develop construction drawings and technical specifications that will serve as the basis for a formal, separately issued construction solicitation. Installation and construction services will not be awarded under this solicitation and will be procured separately after submittal and approval by Nevada State Public Works Division. The project scope includes structure and equipment procurement and consulting services to develop final design drawings and specifications. The basis of design are the attached drawings and renderings produced by JKAE. The University will contract with a separate site design team that will be responsible for the required site renovations and providing the necessary utilities to the proposed structure.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Site Evaluation/Selection, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
